# WBX2
> WBX2 provides AI-powered customer support and knowledge management tools for websites and businesses.

WBX2 appears to focus on AI chat, support automation, and website-integrated assistant experiences. This llms.txt highlights the main public-facing pages, product information, company resources, and contact paths available on the site.

## Main
- [Home](https://wbx2.com/): Overview of WBX2’s AI support platform, positioning, and primary product messaging.
- [About](https://wbx2.com/about): Company background, mission, and high-level information about the team and business.
- [Contact](https://wbx2.com/contact): Contact form and business inquiry page for reaching the WBX2 team.
- [Pricing](https://wbx2.com/pricing): Pricing information for WBX2 plans, features, and subscription options.

## Product
- [AI Chatbot](https://wbx2.com/ai-chatbot): Product page for the website chatbot and automated customer interaction capabilities.

- [Customer Support](https://wbx2.com/customer-support): Overview of support automation and customer service use cases.
- [Website Assistant](https://wbx2.com/website-assistant): Details on embedding an AI assistant into a website experience.
